message:
Uploads of 8 MB now work. The limit in `config/default.json` was `uploads.maxMb: 5`, and I changed it to `10` to match `docs/product.md`. `npm test` passes, including the uploads tests.

The API body limit in `src/api/body-limit.js` is computed from the same setting, so it now allows 11 MB (10 MB plus 1 MB for multipart overhead).
